_comment: Unified portfolio + strategy config. Top-level keys are DEFAULTS; per-asset entries inherit and can override any field — including the entire 'strategy' block. Edit this file live while unified_runner.py --vim is running: the dashboard auto-reloads on save.

_strategy_defaults._comment: Strategy parameters — single source of truth. The snake_case keys matching engine::StrategyConfig names are read DIRECTLY by the Rust engine (per-ticker: _strategy_defaults + this asset's strategy overrides). Research-only parameters (feature windows, columns, model path) are kept here so there is a single source of truth for the whole stack.

_regime_gate._comment: Regime detection (meta-labeller) gate - the model that sits between the executor and execution. The switch is enable_regime_detection (TOP-LEVEL or per-asset, strict true|false): true = every entry the executor would take must ALSO pass the regime decision tree build/regime_gate.json (rejected candidates are shadow-logged to build/gate_log_<id>.jsonl); false = the executor runs pure, gate OPEN. To A/B the gate on the SAME ticker: duplicate the asset entry, give it a unique id (e.g. eth-raw), set per-asset enable_regime_detection to the opposite value, and compare net($)/totR between the two dashboard rows - each twin keeps its own RocksDB store (data/portfolio_<id>.rocksdb), gate log and HTML report. Export a gate with: python tools/export_regime_gate.py
